title: EDGAR 8-K item codes, one row per (filing, item) (schema_version 1)
description: One row of fundamentals_pit/filing_8k_items/v1/quarters/{YYYY}q{N}.parquet. Producer: collectors/filing_8k_items_pit.py (rows_in_block, then run() adds schema_version). A filing with no item codes is one row with item ''. PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_pit_dataset_contracts.py. The x-pit declaration states the collector's own knowledge rule (filing_date < S); acceptance_datetime is carried as EDGAR reports it but is not the rule, because its clock is not verified here. alpha-engine-config-I12567 (DATA-01, second slice).

ticker.description: The issuer's CURRENT ticker from the EDGAR PIT facts run, not the ticker on the filing date (alpha-engine-config-I12568).

filing_date.description: EDGAR filingDate. The availability date: admissible for session S only when filing_date < S.

acceptance_datetime.description: EDGAR acceptanceDateTime verbatim, or '' when EDGAR reports none.

report_date.description: EDGAR reportDate, the date of the earliest event reported; null when EDGAR reports none.

item.description: One item code (e.g. '2.02'); '' for a filing with no codes.

x-pit.rule: EDGAR stamps each filing with its filing date (a filing accepted after 17:30 ET carries the next business day), so a row is admissible for session S only when filing_date < S. An amendment is a separate 8-K/A accession with its own filing date and never rewrites the original row, so a published row is final.
